data.taxBenefit: NHR (Non-Habitual Resident) regime used to offer 20% flat tax on local income and exemptions on foreign income. Note: NHR is undergoing legislative changes in 2024; consult a local advisor.

fees.totalEstimated: ~€260 EUR (~$285 USD) + NIF & Portuguese bank setup

requirements: Proof of remote income equivalent to 4x the Portuguese minimum wage (~EUR 3,280/month).
NIF (Tax Identification Number) and a Portuguese bank account.
Proof of accommodation in Portugal for at least 1 year.
Clean criminal record.
data.governingBody: Ministry of Foreign Affairs & AIMA (Portugal)

data.stayDuration: 1 Year via embassy or 3 Years via UGE (Renewable up to 5 Years)
data.taxBenefit: Eligible for Beckham Law regime offering a reduced flat tax rate of 24% on Spanish income for up to 6 years.

fees.applicationFee: €73.26 EUR (Consular visa fee) or €73.26 EUR (UGE in-country fee)

requirements: Proof of remote employment or freelance work with non-Spanish companies for at least 3 months.
Minimum monthly income of at least 200% of the Spanish minimum wage (~EUR 2,646/month).
Clean criminal record check from countries of residence over the last 5 years.
Comprehensive private health insurance valid in Spain with no co-payments.
data.governingBody: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, European Union and Cooperation (Spain) & UGE

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from local income tax during the 6-month stay for residents of eligible tax-treaty countries.
requirements: Annual income of at least 10,000,000 JPY (or foreign currency equivalent)
Citizenship of a visa-exempt country with a tax treaty with Japan
Private health insurance covering injury and medical care for the full stay
data.governingBody: Immigration Services Agency of Japan (ISA) & Ministry of Foreign Affairs

data.taxBenefit: Tax residency is triggered if staying more than 183 days in a 12-month period, subject to standard flat personal income tax rate or tax treaty protections.
requirements: Proof of location-independent work using telecommunications technology
Active employment with a foreign company, foreign business ownership, or foreign freelance clients
Gross monthly income of at least EUR 4,500 for the preceding 6 months
Valid health insurance coverage for the full duration of stay
data.governingBody: Police and Border Guard Board (PPA) & Enterprise Estonia (e-Residency)

data.taxBenefit: Full exemption from Croatian personal income tax on remote foreign income
requirements: Proof of remote work for a company or own business outside Croatia
Minimum monthly income of EUR 2,539 (or equivalent in savings)
Valid passport with validity extending 3 months beyond the intended stay
Comprehensive health insurance covering the territory of Croatia
data.governingBody: Ministry of the Interior (MUP Croatia)

data.stayDuration: 3 to 12 months (Renewable up to an additional 12 months)
data.taxBenefit: Foreign-sourced income is generally exempt from local personal income tax under Malaysia's territorial tax system.
requirements: Minimum annual remote income of USD 24,000 (USD 2,000 per month)
Proof of remote employment contract, active freelance client projects, or business ownership
Valid passport with at least 14 months of remaining validity
Health insurance coverage for the duration of stay in Malaysia
data.governingBody: Malaysia Digital Economy Corporation (MDEC) & Immigration Department of Malaysia

data.taxBenefit: 50% tax exemption on annual salary income exceeding TWD 3 million for up to 5 years
requirements: Minimum monthly income of TWD 160,000 in one of the past three years
Specialized expertise in one of 10 key professional fields (e.g., Tech, Economy, Finance, Digital)
Valid passport and background check
data.governingBody: National Development Council & Taiwan Employment Gold Card Office

data.taxBenefit: Foreign income is generally subject to personal income tax only if remitted into Thailand while residing as a tax resident.
requirements: At least 20 years of age
Proof of financial funds of at least 500,000 THB
Proof of remote employment, freelance portfolio, or foreign business ownership
data.governingBody: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Thailand) & Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT)

data.taxBenefit: 50% personal income tax reduction for up to 7 years when transferring tax residency to Greece.
requirements: Proof of foreign monthly income of at least EUR 3,500 net.
Proof of remote employment or business activities for clients/employers outside Greece.
Clean criminal record and private health insurance coverage in Greece.
data.governingBody: Ministry of Migration and Asylum & Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Greece)

data.taxBenefit: Tax residents under the 60-day rule benefit from non-domicile tax status, exempting foreign dividends and interest from tax.
requirements: Proof of net monthly income of at least EUR 3,500
Remote work contract or foreign client proof
Valid comprehensive health insurance
Clean criminal record from country of origin
data.governingBody: Civil Registry and Migration Department (Ministry of Interior, Cyprus)

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from Icelandic income tax for stays up to 180 days
requirements: Proof of remote employment, freelancing, or business ownership outside Iceland
Minimum monthly income of 1,000,000 ISK for an individual (1,300,000 ISK for couples)
Comprehensive health insurance covering the duration of stay in Iceland
Valid passport and clean criminal record
data.governingBody: Directorate of Immigration (Útlendingastofnun, Iceland)

data.processingTime: Instant (No visa required prior to arrival)
data.taxBenefit: Reduced tax rate under Svalbard tax law (approx 16.2% flat income tax) and no VAT
requirements: Sufficient financial self-sufficiency to cover living costs on Svalbard
Arranged housing accommodation prior to arrival
Valid passport and transit visa if passing through mainland Norway
data.governingBody: Governor of Svalbard (Sysselmesteren på Svalbard)

data.taxBenefit: Option to participate in the flat-rate tax scheme (paušální daň), simplifying income tax, social security, and health insurance into a single monthly payment.
requirements: Active Czech Trade License (Živnostenský list)
Proof of available funds (minimum ~156,500 CZK in a bank account)
Proof of accommodation in the Czech Republic for the duration of stay
Clean criminal record from home country and recent countries of residence
data.governingBody: Ministry of the Interior of the Czech Republic (MVCR)

data.taxBenefit: Possibility to apply for the Impatriati regime offering income tax reductions for qualifying foreign workers.
requirements: Minimum annual income of EUR 28,000 (approx. EUR 2,333/month) from remote work
Proof of highly qualified remote employment or freelance work for at least 6 months
Comprehensive health insurance covering medical treatment in Italy
Proof of suitable accommodation in Italy and clean criminal record
data.governingBody: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI) & Ministry of Interior

data.taxBenefit: Foreign remote income is exempt from Romanian income tax and social security contributions.
requirements: Proof of remote employment or business ownership registered outside Romania for at least 3 months
Proof of minimum income of 3,700 EUR per month (3x Romanian average gross salary) for the last 6 months
Valid health insurance covering Romania for the visa duration
Clean criminal record certificate
data.governingBody: General Inspectorate for Immigration (IGI Romania) & Ministry of Foreign Affairs

data.taxBenefit: No local personal income tax or capital gains tax on foreign income.
requirements: Demonstrate a continuous source of income or substantial financial means
Valid health insurance coverage in Bermuda
Proof of employment with a foreign entity or ownership of a foreign company
Clean criminal background check and valid passport
data.governingBody: Department of Immigration & Bermuda Tourism Authority (BTA)

data.taxBenefit: No personal income tax, tax on capital gains, or foreign income tax in the Bahamas.
requirements: Proof of remote employment, self-employment, or student enrolment outside The Bahamas
Valid passport with sufficient validity
Proof of medical insurance coverage including health care in The Bahamas
data.governingBody: Bahamas Ministry of Tourism, Investments & Aviation

data.visaName: Digital Nomad Visa (Estancia para Trabajadores Remotos)
data.taxBenefit: Exempt from Costa Rican income tax on foreign-earned income and import duty exemption on work equipment.
requirements: Proof of stable foreign income of at least $3,000 USD per month for individuals or $4,000 USD for families
Valid health insurance policy covering the applicant and dependents for the full duration of stay
Proof of remote employment, freelancing, or business ownership outside Costa Rica
data.governingBody: Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería (Costa Rica)

data.taxBenefit: Tax residency applies after 183 days of residence within a 12-month period.
requirements: Proof of remote employment or freelance work with foreign entities
Minimum monthly income of $1,500 USD or bank account balance of $18,000 USD
Valid health insurance valid in Brazil
Clean criminal background check
data.governingBody: National Immigration Council (CNIg) & Ministry of Justice and Public Security (Brazil)

data.stayDuration: 180 Days (Renewable once for up to 180 Days)
data.taxBenefit: No local income tax on foreign-sourced earnings during the 180-day temporary stay.
requirements: Proof of remote work contract, freelance services, or company ownership outside Argentina
Valid passport and detailed professional CV or portfolio
Clean criminal background check from country of origin or residence
data.governingBody: Dirección Nacional de Migraciones (DNM Argentina) & Visit Argentina

data.taxBenefit: Foreign income is tax-exempt as long as it is not remitted into a Mauritian bank account.
requirements: Proof of monthly income of at least USD 1,500
Main source of income and business activity outside Mauritius
Valid travel and health insurance covering the duration of stay
Valid passport and return/onward flight ticket
data.governingBody: Economic Development Board Mauritius (EDB) & Passport and Immigration Office

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from local income tax on income generated outside Seychelles
requirements: Valid passport for the full duration of stay
Proof of remote employment, freelance contracts, or company ownership outside Seychelles
Proof of sufficient financial means and medical insurance
data.governingBody: Department of Immigration and Civil Status (Seychelles)

data.stayDuration: Up to 1 Year (Renewable up to 3 Years)
data.taxBenefit: Foreign income exempt from local income tax if spending less than 183 days in South Africa in a 12-month period.
requirements: Minimum annual income requirement of 1,000,000 ZAR (~83,333 ZAR per month)
Proof of remote employment, freelancing, or business ownership outside South Africa
Comprehensive health insurance for the entire duration of stay
Valid passport and clean criminal background check
data.governingBody: Department of Home Affairs (DHA, South Africa)

data.taxBenefit: 0% personal income tax rate.
requirements: Valid passport with at least 6 months validity
Proof of employment or company ownership (1+ year contract)
Health insurance with UAE coverage valid for the duration of stay
Pay slips for the last month and bank statements for the preceding 3 months
data.governingBody: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET) & GDRFA Dubai

data.taxBenefit: Foreign income is exempt from domestic Korean taxation; strictly prohibits employment or commercial activity with Korean entities.
requirements: Proof of annual income exceeding 2x Korea GNI per capita (~88,000,000 KRW / ~$66,000 USD / ~$5,500/mo)
At least 1 year of employment in the same industry with a foreign company
Private medical insurance covering over 100,000,000 KRW (~$75,000 USD) including medical evacuation
Apostilled clean criminal background check from home country
data.governingBody: Ministry of Justice (Korea Immigration Service)

data.taxBenefit: Nomad-specific flat tax rate of 10% on qualifying remote income, exempting foreign non-remitted funds.
requirements: Gross monthly income of at least EUR 2,700 (~$2,950 USD)
Valid employment or freelance contract with entities registered outside Malta
Proof of valid lease accommodation in Malta
Comprehensive medical insurance policy covering Schengen area
data.governingBody: Residency Malta Agency (RMA)

data.taxBenefit: 0% tax on foreign-sourced income earned from employers or clients outside Indonesia.
requirements: Annual remote salary/earnings of at least $60,000 USD (~$5,000/month)
Proof of continuous employment contract or business ownership outside Indonesia
Bank statement showing minimum balance of $2,000 USD
Valid passport with at least 6 months validity
data.governingBody: Directorate General of Immigration (Kemenkumham Indonesia)

data.stayDuration: Up to 2 Years (180 days per calendar year without tax residency trigger)
data.taxBenefit: Exempt from local income taxation if physical stay remains under 183 days in a 365-day rolling window.
requirements: Minimum monthly income of 3x Colombian minimum wage (~$1,500 USD/month)
Letter from foreign employer or freelance contracts in Spanish/English
Health insurance policy covering international medical expenses and repatriation in Colombia
Bank statements showing qualifying deposits for the last 3 months
data.governingBody: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Cancillería de Colombia)

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from Hungarian personal income tax for the first 6 months of residency.
requirements: Monthly verified income of at least EUR 3,000 for the preceding 6 months
Employment with a company outside Hungary or shareholding in a foreign enterprise
Valid lease agreement in Hungary and comprehensive health insurance
Clean criminal record
data.governingBody: National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing (OIF Hungary)

data.stayDuration: 1 Year (Renewable up to 4 Years, leading to Permanent Residency)
data.taxBenefit: Foreign remote income is exempt from Mexican tax as long as income is not paid by a Mexican legal entity.
requirements: Monthly income of approx. $3,200-$3,600 USD for the last 6 months OR bank balance of $54,000+ USD for 12 months
Proof of remote employment, freelancing, or investments outside Mexico
Valid passport and consular appointment in home country
Exchange visa sticker for Canje resident card at INM within 30 days of arrival
data.governingBody: Instituto Nacional de Migración (INM) & Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores (SRE)

data.stayDuration: 360 Days (Visa-Free for 95+ nationalities, easily reset via border run)
data.processingTime: Instant arrival / 10 business days for Individual Entrepreneur tax status
data.taxBenefit: Eligible for Small Business Status offering a flat 1% income tax rate on annual revenue up to 500,000 GEL (~$185,000 USD).
requirements: Minimum monthly income of $2,000 USD or equivalent in savings
Citizen of one of the 95+ visa-free countries
Valid health insurance policy for full stay duration
Proof of remote contracts or freelance portfolio
data.governingBody: Ministry of Economy and Sustainable Development & Public Service Hall (Georgia)

data.taxBenefit: 100% exemption from Barbados local personal income tax on foreign-earned income.
requirements: Annual remote income expectation of at least $50,000 USD (~$4,166/month)
Employment with a company outside Barbados or independent remote business
Valid passport with at least 6 months validity
Proof of international health insurance
data.governingBody: Barbados Immigration Department & Ministry of Tourism and International Transport

data.visaName: Short Stay Visa for Remote Workers
data.stayDuration: 9 Months (Renewable for an additional 9 months; 18 months total)
data.taxBenefit: Strict territorial tax system: 0% tax on foreign-sourced earnings earned outside Panama.
requirements: Annual foreign-sourced income of at least $36,000 USD ($3,000/month) + $1,000/mo per dependent
Proof of remote employment, services, or business operations outside Panama
Clean criminal background check from home country (apostilled)
Comprehensive medical insurance valid in Panama
data.governingBody: Servicio Nacional de Migración (Panama)

data.taxBenefit: Full exemption from Montenegrin personal income tax for qualifying digital nomads.
requirements: Proof of remote monthly income of at least 3x the Montenegrin minimum wage (~€1,400/month)
Employment with a non-Montenegrin company or foreign registered business ownership
Registered residential lease in Montenegro
Clean criminal record check and private health insurance
data.governingBody: Ministry of Internal Affairs (MUP Montenegro)

data.taxBenefit: Foreign remote income remains untaxed in Turkey if staying under 183 days per calendar year.
requirements: Ages 21 to 55 from qualifying countries (EU, UK, US, Canada, etc.)
Proof of monthly income of $3,000 USD or $36,000 USD annually
University degree or verified higher educational diploma
Valid passport with at least 6 months validity
data.governingBody: Ministry of Culture and Tourism (GoTürkiye) & Directorate General of Migration Management (GÖÇ)
